expect.why: reveal.js's own .aria-status live region: a 1×1 px box clipped to a zero area (clip: rect(1px, 1px, 1px, 1px)) at (0, 0) that repeats the current slide's text. A literal reading of section 10 step 4 would count it (its rect is non-zero), but it shows nothing, it is built at runtime so it could never map, and it repeats every run of the slide, so every probe sentinel would appear in it too. The walk skips text in absolutely positioned elements clipped to a zero area (core/dom-walk.ts WalkOptions.skipClipped), so it is never counted; were it counted it would be none (no-match)
